entities.name: Query protein 508 aa
observations: Sequence length is 508 aa; estimated molecular mass is 53.845 kDa.
Predicted theoretical pI is 7.00, near-neutral; instability index 29.19 and GRAVY -0.0388.
Homologous to reviewed UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligases with 46.5–50.1% identity and 92.7–96.3% coverage.
Pfam domains Mur_ligase_M (PF08245) occur at residues 125–330 and Mur_ligase_C (PF02875) at residues 353–479.
Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent incorporation of meso-diaminopimelate into the UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu precursor during peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
Homology-supported Mg2+ dependence and cytosolic localization are inferred from curated reference proteins; the query itself was not experimentally characterized.

entities.name: MurE ligase
observations: MurE ligases are ATP-dependent bacterial peptidoglycan enzymes that add meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu.
The query sequence contains both conserved Mur ligase middle and C-terminal domains and matches reviewed MurE proteins across most of its length.

entities.name: MurE ligase reaction
observations: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate + meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP yields UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ADP + phosphate + H+.
The candidate reaction is EC 6.3.2.13 and is mapped to Rhea RHEA:23676 in the reference annotations.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE activity supplies the diaminopimelate-containing stem peptide precursor used in bacterial cell-wall peptidoglycan assembly.
Close reviewed homologs are annotated to bacterial cell-wall biogenesis, peptidoglycan biosynthesis, cell division, and regulation of cell shape.
